'''Maria Moles Farré''' (born 8 May 2003) is an Andorran [[women's association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] for the youth team of Spanish club [[FC Levante Las Planas]] and the [[Andorra women's national football team|Andorra women's national team]].

==Club career==
Moles is a product of [[FC Levante Las Planas|Levante Las Planas]] in Spain.

==International career==
Moles capped for Andorra at senior level in a 4–2 [[Exhibition game|friendly]] away win over [[Liechtenstein women's national football team|Liechtenstein]] on 18 September 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lfv.li/nationalmannschaften/spielbericht?cfc_league_fe%5BmatchId%5D=179758&cHash=83ea0d30b7e7f9dd485ef972cee5dc55|title=Spielbericht|website=Liechtenstein Football Association|language=de|date=18 September 2021|accessdate=22 September 2021}}</ref>
